home.title: Seen harm to nature? Report it anonymously.
home.intro: Illegal dumping, damaged mangroves, disturbed turtle nests, reef damage, poaching: send a photo and the location, and we pass it on to the responsible agency.
home.how1: Take one or more photos. Don't put yourself at risk.
home.how2: Mark the place on the map of Aruba.
home.how3: Choose what you saw and send. No name, no account.
home.how4: You get a code and a secret to follow your report.

about.title: About ROCAN
about.p1: ROCAN lets anyone report harm to nature in Aruba, anonymously and from their phone.
about.p2: Each report is checked and sent to the responsible agency: the Directie Natuur en Milieu, the Aruba Conservation Foundation (for Arikok National Park and Parke Marino) or Directie Openbare Werken. Agencies are asked to confirm receipt within 7 days.
about.p3: Every month a summary of all reports, and of how agencies responded, is sent to the Public Prosecutor's Office (OM Aruba).
about.p4: ROCAN is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 911.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: ROCAN is built so we can't know who you are.
privacy.notStored: Your name, phone number, email, IP address, browser or device details. There are no accounts and no trackers.
privacy.stored: Your photos, the location you chose, the category, your description and when you sent it. The time and place a photo was taken (from the photo itself) is kept as evidence. Other information hidden in photos, such as the camera model or serial number, is removed.
privacy.evidence: The original photos are locked away unchanged so they can serve as evidence. Agencies receive copies without hidden camera data, and faces or license plates can be blurred.
privacy.secret: Only you have the secret words. We store a one-way fingerprint of them, so we can check them but not read them.
privacy.ai: Photos (without hidden camera data) and descriptions may be analysed automatically to suggest a category. A person checks the result before anything is sent.
privacy.retention: Reports that are not forwarded are deleted after 90 days. Other reports are kept for 5 years.
